config.notes: Academies Australasia Institute (academies.edu.au/courses-<city>-<area>/). One shared page per study area covers several qualifications; each block prints 'CRICOS Course Code: <code> Duration: N terms (X college weeks) Cost: A$Y /term', so duration and the per-term cost are read per course with {code} for review only (location field holds the per-term cost). Fees are per term only (lesson 7, open item 3: not readable until per-term annualisation exists); the general reader's per-term figures are excluded as fees for every read course. No intakes and no IELTS on course pages. 095624D is bound to a 2025 news post and 9 courses to the pathways page or the intranet (identity mismatch); no evidenced course URL in stored links, so not rebound (needs a person).
